articles.title: Polymarket updates new $25 referral code “OREGON” for Warriors-Trail Blazers NBA
articles.summary: Polymarket dropped a $25 referral code called "OREGON" timed to the Warriors-Trail Blazers game, signaling the platform's continued push to convert casual NBA fans into prediction market users. The move shows Polymarket is willing to spend real money during high-volume sports moments to grab market share before regulatory scrutiny potentially tightens.

articles.title: Blockchain Prediction Markets and AI Agents Redefine Information Finance Amid Election Scrutiny + Video
articles.summary: Blockchain-based prediction markets are increasingly powered by AI agents that can process and trade on information at inhuman speeds, all while regulators squint nervously at election betting. If these systems work as advertised, they'll either democratize price discovery in political events or become the next flash-crash waiting to happen.

articles.title: Did Prediction Market Push Just Shift Cboe Stock's Investment Narrative?
articles.summary: Cboe's stock narrative just got hijacked by prediction market hype, suggesting retail money and media attention are reshaping how traditional financial infrastructure plays get valued. If a speculative surge can move legacy exchange stocks, that's a tell that prediction markets themselves are graduating from niche betting to real portfolio rotators.

articles.title: Kalshi Promotes Prediction Market as Hedging Solution for Small Businesses
articles.summary: Kalshi is pitching prediction markets as a legit way for small business owners to hedge their operational risks instead of relying solely on insurance and traditional financial instruments. If it sticks, this could dramatically expand the total addressable market for prediction markets beyond the degenerate bettor demographic that currently dominates.

articles.title: CoreWeave Eyes $4.5B Loan, but Bankruptcy Odds Rise to 21% on Prediction Markets
articles.summary: CoreWeave, a GPU infrastructure startup, is trying to raise $4.5B while traders are betting 21% odds the company goes bankrupt. That tension between mega-funding rounds and genuine insolvency risk is exactly the kind of mispricing that makes for interesting market opportunities.

articles.title: It’s up to Congress to clean up the country’s prediction-market mess
articles.summary: Congress is finally acknowledging that prediction markets need actual rules instead of the legal gray zone they've been operating in. If they actually legislate this space, we're either getting a legitimacy boost that transforms these markets into real price-discovery engines, or we're getting regulations so restrictive that half the interesting bets disappear.

articles.title: Kalshi traders bet on how many presidential actions Trump will sign this week
articles.summary: Kalshi's Trump action market is testing whether prediction markets can keep pace with executive velocity, with traders now betting on sub-weekly granularity for presidential orders. If this resolves cleanly, it validates the appetite for hyper-specific policy futures and sets a template for other high-frequency political events.

articles.title: How Louisiana became a battleground in the national fight over prediction markets
articles.summary: Louisiana's regulatory crackdown on prediction markets is forcing the industry to fight on unfamiliar legal ground, turning a single state into a test case for broader restrictions. If Louisiana succeeds in boxing out the platforms, it'll give other states a roadmap to follow, and suddenly your favorite markets could vanish overnight.

articles.title: Opinion | Kalshi’s sports bets are everywhere. They’re also likely illegal.
articles.summary: Kalshi, a CFTC-regulated prediction market platform, is reportedly offering sports betting products that may violate federal and state gambling laws. If regulators crack down, it could signal that the line between legal prediction markets and illegal sports gambling isn't where the industry thought it was.

articles.title: Tickmill Is Launching Prediction Markets
articles.summary: Tickmill, a forex and CFD broker, is building its own prediction markets platform to let traders bet on real-world events alongside traditional financial instruments. Another major financial player entering the space means deeper liquidity, better odds, and more competition for the existing prediction market heavyweights like Polymarket.

articles.title: Most Polymarket users lost money betting on the U.S. midterms, report finds
articles.summary: A majority of Polymarket traders got rekt betting on the 2022 midterms, suggesting that retail prediction market participants are roughly as skilled at forecasting as a coin flip. This matters because it validates the criticism that prediction markets only work when serious money shows up to correct amateur mistakes, which isn't exactly a ringing endorsement for crowd wisdom.

articles.title: LA Lakers announce deal with Kalshi, signaling sports leagues’ growing embrace of prediction markets
articles.summary: The LA Lakers just inked a deal with Kalshi, the CFTC-regulated prediction market platform, marking the first major U.S. sports league partnership with a legal prediction market operator. This blows open the mainstream credibility door for prediction markets, suggesting the regulatory and cultural gatekeepers are finally accepting that these platforms aren't just crypto gambling dens.
